snippet.title: Korea. IL-2 Series — Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Korea. IL-2 Series is available now!

Take your seat in the cockpit and enter the skies of the Korean War — jets and piston aircraft, aerial combat, Commander Career, and a vast world await.

Thank you to everyone who joined us on the journey to release. See you in the skies! 

Follow the IL-2 Series on our official platforms and stay connected with 
the community:

Website: https://il2-series.com/en/
Forum: https://forum.il2-series.com
Discord:  https://discord.gg/QksFqpX7Uy  
Telegram: https://t.me/il2gb
Reddit:   / il2series
